caption:
Sticky Asian Meatballs 
high protein | meal prep 

Nutrition: 
C: 11 | F: 13 | P: 37
Calories: 317 per portion 
Makes 3 portions

Ingredients: 
450 grams chicken mince
1 egg
3 spring onion, finely chopped, i prefer greens for this recipe
1 1/2 tbsp minced garlic
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp chilli flakes
1 tsp salt

Sauce
1/8 cup dark soy sauce + 1/8 cup water ( basically 1/4 cup total)
1 tbsp minced garlic
2 tbsp asian green chilli sauce (i used the ready made store one)
1 packet monkfruit
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp cornflour + 2 tbsp water - make a slurry

Method
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl for the meatballs and keep in the fridge for an hour
You can add 2-3 tbsp corn flour or bread crumbs if you want to achieve perfect round meatballs, I don’t :) 

Cook the meatballs in a pan , I used a tsp of oil you can choose not to 

For the sauce, Add the ingredients as shown in the video to a pan and let it thicken 

Add in the cooked meatballs and coat fully

Serve as a starter plain or with rice or Hakka noodles
